description: This file defines a stub module for plugin SDK, implemented via a Proxy object to intercept various operations and provide default behaviors or values.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Intercepts function call applications on the stub object, returning itself.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Intercepts construction of new instances via the stub object, returning itself.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Intercepts property accesses, returning default or primitive values based on property name.

methods.name: ownKeys
methods.description: Provides the list of keys, including special keys '__esModule' and 'default'.

methods.name: getOwnPropertyDescriptor
methods.description: Provides property descriptors for special properties or defaults to Reflect.
